name: Katarzyna Lewandowska
bio:
Katarzyna's journey in motorsport began unconventionally. After earning a degree in engineering, she initially joined a small rally team as a data analyst. Her sharp eye for detail and ability to translate complex data into actionable insights quickly caught the attention of team management. This led to a rapid ascent through the ranks, eventually taking on managerial responsibilities within the team. 

Her transition to Rahal Letterman Lanigan was driven by a desire to apply her analytical and leadership skills at the highest levels of motorsport. Katarzyna is known for her rigorous, data-driven approach to team management, emphasizing meticulous preparation and strategic decision-making. Her demanding nature stems from a belief that unwavering focus and attention to detail are crucial for success in a fiercely competitive environment. She is also known for her innovative strategies on track, and her cool demeanor under pressure during race weekends.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, neatly styled with subtle waves
physical.description: Katarzyna has a commanding presence, accentuated by her sharp features and focused gaze.

quirks: Insists on having a perfectly organized desk at all times.
Always carries a small notebook to jot down observations and ideas.
Has a habit of tapping her pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
